answer_1.quote: We suggest a sarcastic paraphrase generator. They assume that the input is always of negative polarity, and suggest an unsupervised pipeline of four modules to convert such an input u (-) to a sarcastic version.

answer_4.quote: we published on the Prolific Academic crowdsourcing platform
answer_4.guideline: For each response, you will be asked to specify, on a scale from 1 to 5: (a) How sarcastic it is; (b) How funny it is; (c) How coherent it is to the original text; It is coherent if it sounds like a reasonable response that a person might give. (d) How specific it is to the original text
